verdict.rationale: Slate is a general-purpose terminal coding agent. It can run shell commands, work across long multi-hour sessions and run parallel subagents, which implies it could handle routine maintenance tasks. The only task-specific evidence is the docs' claim that it can perform integration tests manually, and that is about running tests rather than writing them. Missing for 10: documented support for writing tests, fixing lint errors, resolving merge conflicts and updating dependencies, plus any hands-on or independent confirmation of these tasks.
